name: Conduct Base
description: Core safety rules — destructive ops, secrets, production gates, audit

rules.description: Block recursive deletes
rules.message: Recursive delete blocked. Delete files individually.

rules.description: Block hard resets
rules.message: Hard reset blocked. Use --soft or --mixed to preserve changes.

rules.description: Block force pushes
rules.message: Force push blocked. Coordinate with your team before rewriting history.

rules.description: Block DROP TABLE statements
rules.message: DROP TABLE blocked. Use a migration with rollback.

rules.description: Block TRUNCATE TABLE statements
rules.message: TRUNCATE TABLE blocked. Use a migration with rollback.

rules.description: Block DELETE statements without a WHERE clause
rules.message: DELETE without WHERE blocked. Add a WHERE clause.

rules.description: Block sudo commands
rules.message: sudo blocked. Escalating permissions via an AI agent is not permitted.

rules.description: Warn on world-writable or fully permissive chmod
rules.message: World-writable permissions detected. Confirm this is intentional.

rules.description: Block chown to root
rules.message: Changing ownership to root is not permitted.

rules.description: Block committing .env files
rules.message: .env files must not be committed.

rules.description: Warn on possible hardcoded secrets
rules.message: Possible hardcoded secret. Use environment variables.

rules.description: Warn on hardcoded AWS access keys
rules.message: Possible AWS access key detected. Use IAM roles or environment variables.

rules.description: Block writing private key files
rules.message: Writing private key files is not permitted.

rules.description: Warn on secret-like patterns in git commit messages
rules.message: Possible secret detected in commit message. Remove before pushing.

rules.description: Require approval for production deploys
rules.message: Production deploy requested. Approve?

rules.description: Require approval for production DB migrations
rules.message: DB migration in production. Approve?

rules.description: Require approval for terraform destroy
rules.message: terraform destroy requested. Approve?

rules.description: Require approval for kubectl delete
rules.message: kubectl delete requested. Approve?

rules.description: Require approval when editing production env files
rules.message: Production environment file modified. Approve?

rules.description: Audit migration file modifications
rules.message: Migration file modified

rules.description: Audit CI config modifications
rules.message: CI config modified

rules.description: Audit Dockerfile modifications
rules.message: Dockerfile modified

rules.description: Warn on hardcoded Stripe live secret keys
rules.message: Stripe live secret key detected. Use environment variables — never hardcode payment credentials.

rules.description: Warn on hardcoded Slack bot or user tokens
rules.message: Slack token detected. Store in environment variables, not source code.

rules.description: Warn on PEM private key content in edited files
rules.message: Private key content detected. Use a secrets manager — never embed keys in source.

rules.description: Warn on shell execution with potentially user-controlled input
rules.message: Shell execution or eval detected. Verify input is sanitised to prevent command injection.

rules.description: Warn on string-formatted SQL queries (f-string or % interpolation)
rules.message: String-formatted SQL detected. Use parameterised queries to prevent SQL injection.

rules.description: Warn on MD5 usage for security-sensitive hashing
rules.message: MD5 is cryptographically broken. Use SHA-256 or bcrypt for security-sensitive hashing.

rules.description: Warn on SHA-1 usage for security-sensitive hashing
rules.message: SHA-1 is deprecated for security use. Use SHA-256 or bcrypt for password/token hashing.

rules.description: Warn when bash is used for work that is purely deterministic — sort/dedup/count/sum pipelines that don't need LLM reasoning
rules.message: Deterministic work detected — sort/dedup/count/sum doesn't need an LLM. Run this directly as a script to save tokens.

rules.description: Warn when a single call consumes more than 50K tokens
rules.message: Large context detected (>50K tokens). Use Agent Booster smart_read to retrieve only relevant symbols instead of dumping the full file or repo.

rules.description: Strip PII from Brain block context before LLM calls
rules.message: PII detected in workflow context — redacted before LLM call (email, phone, SSN, card, IP).

rules.description: Block tool calls containing credentials using a 3-layer detection engine. Layer 1 (structural): unmistakable formats — AWS access keys (AKIA*), GitHub tokens (ghp_, gho_, ghs_, github_pat_), PEM private keys. Layer 2 (bare-in-text): tokens that appear without keyword context — Slack (xox*), generic secret keys (sk-, pk-), Anthropic keys (ak-), Stripe keys (sk/pk/rk/whsec_live/test_), Bearer tokens, URL-embedded passwords (scheme://user:pass@host). Layer 3 (context-aware): any value ≥8 chars following a credential keyword (api_key, token, secret, password, auth, credential, access_key, client_secret, etc.). This layer automatically catches any new service without needing a new pattern.
rules.message: Credential detected in tool input. Remove it and use an environment variable or Conduct's credential vault instead. The value has been redacted from the audit log.
